title: Free coordinate list outside the list
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\eta$ assign one of the states free, fixed at $1$, or fixed at $-1$ to each of the $n$ coordinates, and let $L$ be a list of coordinates. For any coordinate $i$ not in $L$, the restriction obtained by making every coordinate in $L$ free agrees with $\eta$ at $i$.
hypotheses_covered: $\eta$ assigns a restriction state to each of the $n$ coordinates
